publishedTable.comment: A CSV attachment of a publication published as a queryable table

open-data-tables.title: Open data tables
open-data-tables.description: The rows of every CSV published as a table, one schema per table. The schemas are made by the app when an editor publishes a table, not declared here.

publishedTable.title: Published table
publishedTable.summary: A CSV attachment whose rows can be queried
publishedTable.description: A CSV attachment of a publication whose rows were imported into the open-data-tables register, so anyone who may read the publication can query them and read their data dictionary.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: The publication the CSV is an attachment of.

file.title: File
file.description: The file id of the CSV attachment.

title.title: Title
title.description: The name of the table, by default the file name.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The OpenRegister schema that holds the table's rows; its properties are the data dictionary.

status.title: Status
status.description: importing while the rows are imported, ready once they are, failed when the import refused a row.

lastError.title: Last error
lastError.description: The first row the import refused, and why.
